reference.formulation: Q8 serendipity plane stress, 3x3 Gauss, consistent quadratic edge traction

convergence.meaning: sequence is not monotonically decreasing in the fitted window; no mesh prediction is claimed

recovery_cross_check.meaning: pointwise Q4 recovery of this audit reproduces the stored element-centre stress

element_centre_accuracy.meaning: stored element-centre field exceeds the tolerance on the reported measures

stored element-centre von Mises field is inside the tolerance at every element except the loaded-edge traction-discontinuity corners, measured on both the floored relative error and the global-scale normalised error

scope: Pointwise interior stress components and von Mises at fixed material points (strict interior criterion on points that keep a documented margin from every element interface, plus the legacy interface-coincident points with their two-sided bracket) and the stored element-centre von Mises field (production artefact criterion), both against an independently coded Q8 plane-stress solution with Richardson extrapolation. Element-centre/nodal peak values on the loaded-edge traction discontinuity and at the clamped corner are excluded from the pointwise criteria: those are singular and do not converge pointwise. The reported element-centre measures are a scoped measurement, not a change of the production ``stress_accuracy_qualified`` flag. The strict ladder uses parent points that stay at least 0.1 cell inside an element on every mesh of the ladder.
